Hullo morning crew,

The kennel attendant sent an update on rest areas. Please review the carrier checks before boarding and make sure every transfer note is complete and legible. <<FACT F040>> Keep the pet tags matched to the itinerary papers, confirm water access after each handling change, and report any signs of stress at once. If a traveler asks for reassurance, keep the explanation brief, calm, and consistent with our standard guidance.

For the companion file releases, verify that each kennel door is secured before the ramp is opened and that the floor mats remain dry and stable. Use the approved cleaning wipes only, and replace any item that shows wear before the next handoff. If Mia is listed on the manifest, confirm the comfort blanket is in place and that the crate latch has been checked by a second set of eyes. Please remember that our service depends on careful handovers, clear notes, and steady communication across the shift.

Maintain a professional tone with travelers at all times, and escalate concerns through the regular channel without delay. Thank you for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk dependable and orderly throughout the day. Please carry out these steps exactly as written and support one another during the shift.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
